title: An Analysis of the Coordination Gap between Joint and Modular Learning for Job Shop Scheduling with Transportation Resources
abstract: arXiv:2604.24117v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Efficient job-shop scheduling with transportation resources is critical for high-performance manufacturing. With the rise of "decentralized factories", multi-agent reinforcement learning has emerged as a promising approach for the combined scheduling of production and transportation tasks. Prior work has largely focused on developing novel cooperative architectures while overlooking the question of when joint training is necessary. Joint training denotes the simultaneous training of job and automatic guided vehicle scheduling agents, whereas modular training involves independently training each agent followed by post-hoc integration. In this study, we systematically investigate the conditions under which joint training is essential for optimal performance in the job-shop scheduling problem with transportation resources. translated_title: 带运输资源的作业车间调度中联合学习与模块化学习之间协调差距的分析
translated_abstract: 高效的带运输资源的作业车间调度对于高性能制造至关重要。随着“分散式工厂”的兴起，多智能体强化学习已成为生产与运输任务联合调度的一种有前景的方法。先前的工作主要集中于开发新颖的合作架构，而忽视了何时需要联合训练这一问题。联合训练是指同时训练作业调度智能体和自动引导车（AGV）调度智能体，而模块化训练则是先独立训练每个智能体，再进行事后集成。在本研究中，我们系统地研究了在带运输资源的作业车间调度问题中，联合训练对于实现最优性能至关重要的条件。通过对资源稀缺性和时间主导性的严格敏感性分析，我们量化了协调差距……
tldr: 本研究系统探讨了带运输资源的作业车间调度中联合训练优于模块化训练的适用条件，并通过对资源稀缺性和时间主导性的敏感性分析量化了两者之间的协调差距。
en_tdlr: This study systematically investigates the conditions under which joint training is essential over modular training in job-shop scheduling with transportation resources, quantifying the coordination gap through a rigorous sensitivity analysis of resource scarcity and temporal dominance.
